scope: Exact Lean contract only; native Rust parsing/arithmetic/cardinality and polynomial/complete-cost bridges are not proved. Statement fidelity is a reviewer obligation.
statement: In an additive commutative group G of exact prime cardinality n, a nonzero P generates G; each finite indexed point relation sum(c_i.val times B_i)=a.val times P+b.val times Q implies the corresponding scalar equation sum(c_i*log(B_i))-b*log(Q)=a under the constructed cyclic coordinates.
